summary: Implements design VAL_PILOT_GATE_DESIGN.md §10 step 4 ('Dashboard receipt fourth -- enable receipt writing + CLAIMED/VERIFIED/ACCEPTED rendering via the existing update_dashboard.py path'), following the design's exact §7 receipt schema and CLAIMED/VERIFIED/ACCEPTED vocabulary. Two independently-testable halves: (1) WRITER -- extended scripts/automation/val_pilot_scan.py with an opt-in --write-receipts flag (default remains read-only/zero-writes, preserving the step-3 contract) and write_receipts(), which writes one receipt_version:2 JSON per VERIFIED pilot to automation/val_pilot_receipts/<run_name>_<seed>_eps<epsilon>.json -- never for NO-GO/NEEDS-REVIEW pilots (a receipt asserts completeness, never a failure), and refuses on sight if ever pointed at a results/ tree (hardcoded default path, not exposed as a configurable CLI flag, plus a runtime RuntimeError guard). scan() was extended to carry metadata_path/checkpoint_sha256/pilot_fields through to each report so the writer has everything §7's schema needs, without re-deriving anything verify_pilot() already computed. (2) RENDERER -- new scripts/automation/dashboard_val_pilot_gate.py (dashboard_val_pilot_gate.render_val_pilot_gate), following the exact modular pattern of dashboard_candidate_review.py (a VIEW, never a verdict engine: reads already-written receipt JSON files only, never imports val_pilot_gate_lib/val_pilot_scan, never recomputes a verdict or re-verifies a pilot -- enforced by a grep-based regression test). Renders a new '## 7b. Validation-pilot gate' section (BEGIN/END AUTO:VAL-PILOT-GATE markers) via update_dashboard.py's existing render() pipeline: a CLAIMED/VERIFIED/ACCEPTED candidate-status strip, a validation-read count per candidate (visibility against val-split overfitting, design §7), and a per-pilot table (candidate/seed/epsilon/status/verdict/metrics). A malformed or incomplete individual receipt file is skipped with a named warning rather than aborting the whole section (a directory of independently-written files should never let one bad file hide all the good ones). An empty/missing automation/val_pilot_receipts/ dir renders an honest 'No pilot receipts yet' message, never a fabricated zero-count table. ACCEPTED is read from the receipt's own `acceptance` field, which nothing yet writes -- promoting a VERIFIED pilot receipt to ACCEPTED is deliberately left as separate, later, explicitly-approved work, consistent with the design's 'each step gated on user approval' discipline; every current receipt therefore renders VERIFIED, and the ACCEPTED column will activate automatically once that mechanism exists, with zero renderer changes required. Real end-to-end verification: ran the scanner with --write-receipts against the actual eps=0.015 sweep -- correctly wrote 0 receipts (all 5 axes remain NO-GO/metadata_json_missing, unchanged finding from the step-3 claim) and created no automation/val_pilot_receipts/ directory at all (mkdir only happens inside the per-pilot write branch, never speculatively). Ran the real dashboard render + --check: new '## 7b.' section appears, byte-identical on a second render (idempotent), all pre-existing sections (## 1, ## 2b, ## 7, ## 8-9, etc.) unaffected. Full regression: all 124 tests under scripts/automation/ pass (was 116 before this session's two additions; +5 test_val_pilot_scan.py receipt-writer tests, +13 test_dashboard_val_pilot_gate.py renderer tests -- some overlap with pre-existing counts already covered by earlier receipts this session). No experiment, training, export, threshold selection, or test read occurred at any point. No file under results/ was created or modified.
